session_busy.title: The Daitem panel session is held by another device
session_busy.description:
The panel accepts a single session at a time, across all accounts, and another device has been holding it for several polling cycles. Home Assistant keeps showing the last known state, but cannot read a fresh one or send a command until the session is released.

Close the Daitem app on your phone. If no device is using it, a previous session may have been left open; it is released on its own after a while.

arm_modes_undiscovered.title: Only away arming is available
arm_modes_undiscovered.description:
Home Assistant could not read which arming modes this installation supports, so only away arming is offered for now. This usually means the panel session was held by another device, or the panel was briefly unreachable, when the integration started.

It is retried automatically on the next polling cycles. Close the Daitem app on your phone if it is open, and presence arming comes back on its own within a few minutes.
